CS - Ticket System

The Customer Support Ticketing System is a crucial tool for managing and tracking customer inquiries, issues, and requests. It allows businesses to efficiently resolve customer problems by providing a centralized platform for receiving, prioritizing, and responding to support tickets. This system ensures smooth communication between support teams and customers, enhancing customer satisfaction and operational efficiency.
